results.quote: As a result, it takes quantum operations of order O(_N_<sup>3</sup>) in total to solve the problem, demonstrating that the _N_- Queens Problem can be efficiently solved on a quantum computer in both polynomial time (O(_N_<sup>3</sup>)) and polynomial memory (O(_N_<sup>2</sup>)) using our protocol.

We propose a new algorithm to generate all solutions to the _N_-Queens Problem for a given _N_ in polynomial time of order O(_N_<sup>3</sup>) and polynomial memory of order O(_N_<sup>2</sup>) on a quantum computer.
